newsitem.title: USA: Shaman tests find diarrhea drug effective.
newsitem.headline: Shaman tests find diarrhea drug effective.

text.p: Shaman Pharmaceuticals Inc said the Phase II trial of its Provir drug for travelers diarrhea showed that 89 percent of the 75 patients treated returned to normal bowel function.
It said the test group included 25 patients suffering from traveler's diarrhea and 50 experiencing non-specific diarrhea of unknown origin.

"This suggests that application of this product has the potential for expansion beyond the traveler's diarrhea market," said Lisa Conte, president and chief executive officer of Shaman Pharmaceuticals Inc.
"Based on this data, we expect to initiate a 400 patient, randomized multi-dose, placebo-controlled study in early 1997."
